intro: Tasked directly by Commander Althea Ebonlocke, adventurers are sent into Duskwood's haunted barrows to cull the rising tide of restless dead. This ongoing campaign targets the skeletal horrors clawing their way out of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and Raven Hill. Driving back the skeletal scourge is essential to keeping the fragile haven of Darkshire from falling completely to the darkness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest! If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The undead must be driven from Duskwood!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The people of Darkshire thank you, friend. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
